title: Chapter 138 — Pre-Delivery Communication
intro: Most delivery complaints start before the truck leaves the warehouse.

sections.title: The Confirmation Checklist
sections.content: 48 hours before delivery: confirm date and window by text and email. Remind the customer to clear the path — remove rugs, move furniture, prop open doors. Confirm installation requirements are met — gas line on, water supply accessible, electrical ready. Set expectations: 'The team will call 30 minutes before arrival. Delivery takes about [X] minutes including installation and haul-away.'

sections.title: Pre-Delivery Templates
sections.content:
Text: 'Hi [name], your [appliance] delivery is confirmed for [day] between [window]. Please make sure the pathway is clear and your [gas/water/electric] connections are accessible. The team will call 30 min before arrival. Excited for you!'

Email: Include everything from the text plus the model details, what is included (install, haul-away), and your direct contact info in case anything changes.

This communication cuts 'where is my delivery' calls by 80 percent and dramatically reduces day-of issues.

sections.title: What to Tell the Customer
sections.content:
Have them measure the delivery path — front door width, hallways, staircases. A 36-inch fridge does not fit through a 32-inch doorway. Have them clear the area around the installation location. Have them confirm the old unit is emptied and disconnected if they are handling that themselves.

Every detail you confirm before delivery is one less problem on delivery day.
